No, marketing cannot print "FDA Registered Facility, Reg. No. ____" on the face-cream carton based solely on registration under Part 710. The regulation does not authorize or require such labeling. While a permanent registration number is assigned to a cosmetic product establishment upon registration [1], the text provides no authorization for the use of the phrase "FDA Registered Facility, Reg. No. ____" on packaging. The provision only states that the Commissioner will provide a validated copy of Form FD-2511 as evidence of registration, and this document is sent to the location shown for the registering establishment [1]. There is no requirement or authorization in 21 CFR 710.6 for such labeling on product cartons.

The available regulatory sources do not provide enough information to answer whether such a statement complies with FDA labeling requirements beyond what is specified in 21 CFR 710.6.
